## History

George Fletcher was an acquaintance of [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md). At dawn, after a critical night during [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's severe battle with typhoid fever, [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) passed by [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to deliver the news that Gilbert's fever had broken and he would recover.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Revelation P1](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0001), [v3 ch.Revelation P4](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0004), [v3 ch.Revelation P5](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0005), [v3 ch.Revelation P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006), [v3 ch.Revelation P7](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0007), [v3 ch.Revelation P8](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0008), +12 more_

## Relationships

### [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/george-fletcher--pacifique.md)

[Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) serves as a hired man under George Fletcher's command as of Volume 3. He passes by [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) at dawn following a critical night during [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's illness, delivering the news that Gilbert's fever has broken and he will recover.
